arxiv-2308-05504.title: Detecting and Classifying Bio-Inspired Artificial Landmarks Using In-Air 3D Sonar
arxiv-2308-05504.creator: Maarten de Backer 1 , Wouter Jansen 1 2 3 , Dennis Laurijssen 1 2 , Ralph Simon 4 1 , Walter Daems 1 2 , Jan Steckel 1 2
arxiv-2308-05504.description: Abstract Various autonomous applications rely on recognizing specific known landmarks in their environment. For example, Simultaneous Localization And Mapping (SLAM) is an important technique that lays the foundation for many common tasks, such as navigation and long-term object tracking. This entails building a map on the go based on sensory inputs which are prone to accumulating errors.

arxiv-2312-01699.title: Rethinking Urban Mobility Prediction: A Super-Multivariate Time Series Forecasting Approach
arxiv-2312-01699.creator: Jinguo Cheng, Ke Li, Yuxuan Liang, Lijun Sun, Junchi Yan, Yuankai Wu
arxiv-2312-01699.description: Abstract Long-term urban mobility predictions play a crucial role in the effective management of urban facilities and services. Conventionally, urban mobility data has been structured as spatiotemporal videos, treating longitude and latitude grids as fundamental pixels. Consequently, video prediction methods, relying on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs), have been instrumental in this domain.

pmc-11425625.title: Controllable Selective Oxidation of Anilines to Azoxybenzenes and Nitrobenzenes by Regulating the Base
pmc-11425625.creator: Shiyun Li, Wei Zhao, Lulu Wang, Yixiong Jia, Qingyan Cui, Bin Wen, Xingquan Chen
pmc-11425625.description: The importance of selectively oxidizing aniline into value-added chemicals azoxybenzene and nitrobenzene is well-recognized in organic synthesis. However, the lack of control over selectivity and the complex synthesis of costly catalysts significantly hinder these reactions' industrial applications. In this work, an environmentally friendly approach was developed for the selective oxidization of substituted anilines.

pmc-11668145.title: État de mal épileptique chez l'enfant: Facteurs de risque
pmc-11668145.creator: Asma Marzouk, Ilyes Ben Yahia, Meriem Lajili, Nour Jlaila, Rahma Thebti, Asma Bouaziz
pmc-11668145.description: RESUMEIntroduction et objectif: L'état de mal épileptique (EME) chez l’enfant est une situation critique pouvant mettre sa vie en danger. Cette étude avait pour objectif d'identifier les facteurs associés à la survenue d'un EME après une première crise épileptique chez des enfants.

pmc-11670290.title: Comprehensive Targeted and Quantitative Profiling of the Human Milk Metabolome: Impact of Delivery Mode, Breastfeeding Practices, and Maternal Diet
pmc-11670290.creator: Joaquim Calvo‐Lerma, Raúl Cabrera‐Rubio, Carles Lerin, Sonia González, Marta Selma‐Royo, Cecilia Martínez‐Costa, Teodoro Bottiglieri, Maria Carmen Collado
pmc-11670290.description: ScopeHuman milk (HM) is rich in bioactive compounds and essential nutrients. While research has focused on lipids, minerals, immune markers, microbiota, and oligosaccharides, specific metabolites are less studied. This study uses targeted metabolomics to identify and quantify metabolites in HM and explores the impact of perinatal and dietary factors on the metabolomic profile.

pmc-12416026.title: Stakeholder engagement and pharmaceutical pricing regulation: a qualitative inquiry
pmc-12416026.creator: Ye Shing Lourdes Loh, Sharon G M Koh, Audrey K L Siah, Wing Loong Cheong, Tin Tin Su
pmc-12416026.description: BackgroundMedicine affordability is a critical component of a country's redistributive health policies aimed at ensuring equitable access to healthcare. This study aims to investigate key stakeholders’ perspectives on pharmaceutical pricing control in Malaysia as the country is moving towards sustainable healthcare.

pmc-12510067.description: Highligths•Biotechnological routes are increasingly replacing petrochemical methods for succinic acid production.•Escherichia coli and Actinobacillus succinogenes demonstrate high potential for efficient biosuccinic acid production.•The biosuccinic acid market is projected to grow at an annual rate of up to 6.7 % through 2032, offering a sustainable alternative to maleic anhydride.

pmc-12625228.title: Association between magnesium level during hospitalization and venous thromboembolism (VTE) up to 30 days after hospitalization in acutely ill, hospitalized patients, 65 to 90 years old. a retrospective cohort analysis of 6,428 patients
pmc-12625228.creator: Sela O., Dumanis G., Klaiman E., Warschavsky D., Haim S., Elnatan S., Itzhak D., Halperin Y., Segal G., Vaisman A.
pmc-12625228.description: BackgroundHypomagnesemia, known to be associated with physiologic stress and states of inflammation, is also known to be common in acutely ill, hospitalized patients. The potential association between hypomagnesemia and increased risk for VTE (venous thromboembolism) is not well established.MethodsThis was a retrospective analysis of acutely ill, hospitalized elderly patients in a tertiary medical center.

pmc-13182748.title: Newborn IgG and IgM antibodies to maternal SARS-CoV-2 infection in pregnancy and child neurodevelopmental outcomes
pmc-13182748.creator: Lisa A Croen, Yinge Qian, Stacey Alexeeff, Jennifer L Ames, Paul Ashwood, Luke Grosvenor, Danielle HJ Kim, Judy Van de Water, Robert Yolken
pmc-13182748.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Maternal immune activation is a hypothesized mechanism by which prenatal exposure to infection adversely impacts fetal brain development. SARS-CoV-2 IgG class antibodies generated to viral proteins in pregnancy are transferred across the placenta to the newborn.This study aimed to investigate the association between neonatal levels of IgG antibodies to SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid and spike proteins and risk of neurodevelopmental disorders (ND) among children with gestational SARS-CoV-2 exposure.

pmc-13669269.description: Hightlights High-quality, centimeter-sized polycrystalline wafers of a 2D ferroelectric perovskite are fabricated via a facile hot-pressing method, circumventing the challenge of growing large, thick single crystals of 2D perovskites.The preferred horizontal orientation of grains, combined with electric poling, creates macroscopic out-of-plane polarization, generating a strong built-in electric field that boosts interlayer carrier transport.
